title: Branch with a return link
purpose: One decision with two labelled branches and a resubmit link back to the decision. The return link keeps its direction: the cycle is not hidden by reversing an arrow.

inputs.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  draft[Write draft] --> review{Review}
  review -->|approved| publish([Publish])
  review -->|changes requested| revise[Revise draft]
  revise -->|resubmit| review
  publish --> archive[(Archive)]

supported: Mermaid flowchart header with LR direction
decision, stadium and cylinder node shapes
a return edge into an earlier step
